title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Please guide us about the name of girl i.e 'Zulaikha'. Is it permissible or not? 3523 views Q. My best friend has given birth to a girl child.Wondering whether she could be named insha? 2710 views Q. Need Name of boy match with Afraz 3702 views Q. My name is Faiyaz Pathan. Is my name Faiyaz right or wrong 1595 views Q. can i name my daughter afifa wht is it meaning? 2443 views Q. 1. We have named a child Subhan Ahmed Keen, knowing Subhan is name of Allah Subhan wa tallah but since it does not come in the 99 names of Allah we thought it was ok to use it. Now we have read in Maaruf ul Quraan where Mufti Shafi says that except 4-5 names of Allah other names (he mentions Subhan cannot be used; on page 134 Vol4, Aayat 180 of Surat Al Aaraaf) cannot be used. Please guide us. 5060 views Q. Asak Mufti Saheb, While me and my husband were planning for a baby,we did neeyat that if we have a baby boy,we will name him after the name of Hazrat Mohammad (p.b.u.h). By the grace of Allah,through our ultrasound report we get to know that the chances of having a baby boy are higher. My question is :My husband's family name is "Ahmed" which is another name of Hzt. Mohammad(p.b.u.h).So,should I specifically keep my baby's first name after the name of Prophet Mohd.or since the surname of the baby will be Ahmed,so it fulfills our neeyat? I would appreciate your response. AH 1771 views Q. My son name is Mazeen. We only the parents are pronounce the name as it is 1780 views Q. I want to ask you is it right to having names like Rehmatullah, Qudratullah, Hikmatullah, Rahimullah, because these are sifats (attributes) of Allah 2679 views Q. I selected name of my daughter as Khansa after discussing an Alim namely Qari Jameel Ahmed Ziayee but now some Ulama are criticizing and saying for changing name. Respected Mufti sb tell what should I do? 2950 views Q. I keep my son name Mohaamad.but some people says this name should not be kept because if somebody will scold/abuse/tease-your son so it will be insult for prophet also. 2477 views Q. Baby Name 2811 views Q. Islamic baby Boy Name 7049 views Q. Is it permissible to name a baby boy as ARSH? 6782 views Q. براہ کرم، بتائیں کہ درج ذیل نام اچھے ہیں یا نہیں؟دونوں میرے بیٹے ہیں۔ (۱) کنورحسن احمد (۸ سال) کنور داؤد احمد (۶ سال) 1483 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47697 Country: India Title: meaning of name Question: My sister’s name is Anam. I want to know the meaning of this name. Please reply me. Answer ID: 47697 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1440/1077/H=10/1434) We do not know the meaning of it; we searched but could not find the meaning of Anam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
